meta.parties: The General Ceylon Tea Estates Co.,Ltd. v. Pulle

rules.statement: A mala fide possessor is not entitled to utiles impensae unless the owner of the property stood by and allowed the building or planting to proceed without notice of his own claim.
rules.supporting_quote: "My own view is that a mala fide possessor being in effect an intentional wrongdoer ought not to complain, if the utiles impensae incurred ... I would uphold the ruling of the District Judge on this point."
